response.sql:
WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans s
  JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.arcref IS NOT NULL
    AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench_value
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT 
  pr.arcref,
  pr.fundflux,
  pr.rate,
  pr.rate - b.bench_value AS gap
FROM project_rates pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE pr.rate > b.bench_value
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A project's size-per-minute rate is calculated as total file size divided by total scan duration (SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin)), representing overall throughput rather than an average of individual scan rates
Scans with NULL or zero values in gbsize, spanmin, or arcref are excluded from calculations
The benchmark is a simple arithmetic mean of all per-project rates, treating each unique project (arcref, fundflux) pair equally

alternatives.interpretation: Each project's rate could instead be the average of individual scan rates (AVG(gbsize / spanmin)) rather than aggregate throughput. This weights each scan equally regardless of size, whereas SUM/SUM weights larger scans proportionally higher in the project's final rate.
